Brief Title: Study of MEDI-524 (Motavizumab) for the Prophylaxis of Serious Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Disease in High-Risk Children
Primary Outcome Measure: Incidence of RSV Hospitalization (Includes Deaths by RSV); Number of Participants Reporting Any Adverse Events (AEs); Number of Participants Reporting Any Related AEs; Number of Participants Reporting Any Serious Adverse Events (SAEs); Number of Participants Reporting Any Related SAEs; Number of Participants Reporting AEs by Highest Severity Grade; Number of Participants Who Discontinued Study Drug Due to AEs; Number of Participants Who Died; Number of Participants Reporting Changes in Vital Signs From Baseline

Brief Title: A Study to Learn About the Vaccine RSVpreF In Pregnant Participants With HIV and Their Infants
